context_notes: XAML fix is 100% correct. BAML also correct. NW2025 API v22.0.0.0 matches compiled version. All DLLs present in bundle. The failure is that NW2025's CLR cannot find CtrlWizNW.dll's PROJECT-reference dependencies (CtrlWizNW.UI, XInputDotNetPure) from the bundle directory. NW2022 must have an AssemblyResolve handler that probes the plugin directory. NW2025 may use a different loading context (e.g., isolated AssemblyLoadContext) that lacks this handler. Alternative: roamer.exe.config may have changed probing paths.
